lines.text: A few days later...
Privaty is currently away taking care of other matters, leaving me to take care of homeroom in her place.
Ein.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Here.
Zwei.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Here.
While calling attendance...
Arcana.
When I look up, Arcana is nowhere to be seen.
Huh...
Now that I think of it, when we ate dinner together last night,
I remember her saying she didn't feel well.
Amy, you're roommates with Arcana, right?
Did she tell you anything?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Well, not exactly.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: She had just barely gotten up when I was on my way out.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I couldn't say whether she was unwell, though.
Hmm...
Have everyone study on their own, and go check on her.
Tend to the students for now.
I finish attendance and take the tablet.
I'm going to go check if Arcana is okay.
Miss Privaty will be back soon, so just study on your own until she gets here.
I slide the door open and head out.

lines.speaker: whisperingfemalestudent
lines.text: Wow, talk about special treatment.

lines.speaker: gossipingfemalestudent
lines.text: Are they dating?

lines.speaker: gossipingfemalestudent
lines.text: I heard someone saw them together late last night.

lines.speaker: whisperingfemalestudent
lines.text: Really? That confirms it then, right?

lines.speaker: gossipingfemalestudent
lines.text: ... Okay, you have to keep this a secret,

lines.speaker: gossipingfemalestudent
lines.text: but I heard Arcana visits Mr. {AccountData.NickName}'s room a lot.

lines.speaker: whisperingfemalestudent
lines.text: That's messed up...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: ... Rumors are starting to spread.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: It's not really anything to worry about, though, right?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Those two will both be gone after the festival,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: and they were already close to begin with. It's not like they're actually teacher and student.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I hope nothing bad happens.
I leave the classroom to look for Arcana.
... I may be worried, but I can't abandon the students here.
I'll drop by to check on Arcana during break time.
Thanks for telling me, Amy.
Let's proceed with class. Miss Privaty will be back soon.
Privaty comes back around the end of first period, so I leave the students with her and head out to look for Arcana.
After confirming she's not in the dorm, I head to the nurse's office, but...
She's not here either...
She's not answering my calls or reading any of my messages.
Where could she...
*Bzzz*
I get a message from Arcana.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: There you are.
When I arrive, Arcana greets me while lying on the bed, rolling around lazily.
How did you get in here?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's a secret.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Yawn...* I'm tired.
Arcana hugs the pillow.
You need to go to class.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I wanted to take the day off.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Besides...
Arcana sits up.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... can't you just give me private lessons?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You know, where it's just the two of us.
... Arcana.
*Sigh...*
That's not the real problem here.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Then what is it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Give me a hug.
Arcana stretches out both arms.
... The thought of refusing doesn't even occur to me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
As soon as I hug her, Arcana burrows into my arms as if seeking warmth.
... There's nothing wrong with you, is there?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Not at all. In fact, things have been really good lately.
Then...
Arcana slightly pulls away.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I know I've been a lot lately.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I just can't help it... Actually, that's not quite right.
Arcana looks up at me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I probably can, but... I don't want to.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah, I think that's more honest.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I don't want to hold back. I just want to lean on you.
You weren't like this before.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... You're right.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ever since I met you,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and even before I met you, I always held back.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But now...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I mean, this is my first time experiencing something like this, you know?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Being able to put aside my duty,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and just spend quality time with the one person I really care about.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's made me feel more... liberated, both in body and mind.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Actually,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: it's to the point now where I don't want to go back.
Arca...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Just kidding!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If I didn't oversee the Forbidden Library, who would?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Sigh* Something might actually be wrong with me physically, though.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: My physical condition tends to have a big impact on my mental state.
... You're okay, though, right?
Earlier, you were acting a little...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A little what?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Unlike myself?
... Yeah.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You think so? Well...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've always been pretty dependent, and have never been the strongest mentally,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and I like being spoiled.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Does that surprise you? Hehe.
I wouldn't quite call it that...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Everyone lives their life wearing some sort of mask, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I doubt there's anyone who doesn't.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: The reason you're seeing mine come off...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... is because you're you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You know...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'd like to keep being... this. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Not the manager of the Forbidden Archive with a suffocating sense of duty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Just...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: a carefree transfer student who likes her teacher. Is that okay?
... Of course.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're not tired of it? Having to put up with me?
Honestly, a little bit, but...
I actually like it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But what?
... But not to the point of disliking it.
Like you said, we all have different sides to us.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Thank you for saying that.
Arcana hugs me again.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Skip school with me today.
... Okay.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hold me in your arms, and don't let go.
... Okay.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Can I stay over tonight?
No. I'll take you back to your room in a little while.
Sure. Spend the night.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Tch.
You have a roommate, remember? And we can't forget about curfew.
Sleeping over is on a completely different level from just spending time in my room.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Now you're talking like a teacher.
For the time being, I am one.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Says the man who's already done things a teacher shouldn't.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Look, it's fine.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've also done things a student shouldn't do.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That just means...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: we can cozy up together as accomplices.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Okay.
Be careful not to get caught.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's fine. Everyone's probably in class anyway.
Hearing Arcana say it out loud makes me feel rather... immoral.
That's... true.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Everyone's in their classrooms, or in the teachers' office...
Arcana looks out the window.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... or at their workplace. Meanwhile,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: you and I are here together.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Just the two of us.
